The '''Restoration Period''' was a historical era ranging from [[3995 BBY|3995]] to [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]]. During this relatively peaceful time period, [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] struggled to rebuild following the devastation caused by the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. With the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] on the verge of collapse for over a decade following the war, a group of politicians decided to put into motion a series of events that was meant to restore the Republic to its prior strength. By guaranteeing the various corporations throughout the galaxy safe passage and trade along the space-lanes in exchange for commercial investment in the Republic's infrastructure, the Republic was able to rebuild its [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] and provide much-needed goods to the people of the devastated galaxy. 

[[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] explorers once again began to scout the galaxy seeking to discover newer and safer routes. Across the galaxy, [[Planet/Legends|planets]] began to rebuild, commerce resumed, and the Republic's military might was restored.<ref name="KoTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> However, at the same time, the defeated [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who had been on the losing side during the Great Sith War, began to slowly prepare for their revenge against the Republic. Small bases, such as the [[Unity (outpost)|Unity base]] on the planet [[Caillte]] were built in secret during the last months of the Restoration.<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> The [[Mandalorian Wars]] eventually put an end to this period of decades-long peace.<ref name="KoTORCG" />

During this period after the Great Sith War, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] underwent significant reforms. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sought to hold [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchmen]] to higher standards of accountability and implemented more uniform practices across the Order. However, not all members agreed with these reforms, and the council faced a prolonged struggle in establishing unquestioned authority.<ref name="KoTORCG" />

Tensions emerged as differing viewpoints created divisions within the Order, with the council striving to find a balanced approach. While the Republic viewed the Jedi Council’s stricter governance positively, many Jedi accustomed to a more flexible hierarchy considered the council's growing influence overbearing.<ref name="KoTORCG" />
